mentions.name: RCHIVE
mentions.description: This desktop app for Windows, Mac and Linux catalogs, searches and reorganizes files across computers, NAS devices and drives. It scans many sources, provides unified deep search across the entire catalog including drives that are online or offline, lets users virtually organize and clean up large archives, and resiliently copies or moves files when restructuring on disk, with quick browsing via previews and metadata. It works offline, collects zero telemetry, deletes nothing, is fully deterministic in operation, and can run as a portable version from a USB drive.
mentions.problem: Decades of poorly organized files scattered across computers, NAS devices, backups and folders become progressively harder to rein in, and the author's drive starting to fail added urgency to finally organize everything.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building RCHIVE [0], a desktop app for cataloging, searching and reorganizing files on your computers and drives.
mentions.author: kevinsync
